title: Composition
summary: Six quick rules for a stronger frame.

blocks.alt: Six small diagrams: rule of thirds, leading lines, frame in a frame, foreground, horizon on a third, space ahead

items: **Rule of thirds:** put the subject on a line or where two lines cross. Turn on the grid in the camera.
**Leading lines:** roads, rivers and fences that lead the eye to the subject.
**Frame in a frame:** an arch, branches or a window around the subject.
**Foreground:** a rock or flowers close to the lens gives depth to a wide shot.
**Horizon on a third:** low for a great sky, high for a great foreground. Keep it level.
**Space ahead:** leave room in front of anything moving or looking.

blocks.text: These are starting points. Break them when the photo is better for it.
